payload.name: Verify existing coverage before skipping add candidate
payload.description: When a construction decision is about to SKIP an extracted fact with a reason like 'already included' or 'already in memory', verify against the retrieved memory pool and accepted changes before skipping.
content: Before choosing SKIP for an extracted candidate, verify that the fact is actually covered by a retrieved existing memory or by an earlier accepted ADD/UPDATE in the same batch. If no such memory or change exists, do not skip: ADD the candidate as a new memory.
Do not accept a SKIP reason such as 'Information already included in the updated memory' unless you can identify the specific memory ID or change event that contains the same fact.

solves: Construction SKIP can drop valid facts when the model assumes prior coverage ('already included') without checking the existing-memory pool or accepted batch changes. Apply whenever a candidate is about to be SKIPped as duplicate: confirm the fact exists in retrieved memories or earlier accepted updates. Not for cases with actual coverage or retrieval-side issues.
